warning_texts: No rule in audit/check_plan.json compares a claim's declared population field with the population it is computed on: claims_recomputed hardcodes the delivered filter in the plan and caveats_declared only searches caveat text, so gate_claims_machine passed CLM-NET-REVENUE while its population label d

CLM-NET-REVENUE is internally inconsistent: its population field says all orders inside the period while its caveats say delivered orders only, so a release that renders both would tell the reader two different populations for one figure.
summary: All five claim values recompute exactly from raw_data/orders.csv and agree with the metrics registry and gate_claims_machine, whose recalc is rooted only in raw_data/. But CLM-NET-REVENUE declares its population as all orders inside the period, while it is computed on delivered orders only (the all-orders reading gives 41881.34, not 35741.52), which contradicts its own metric and caveats. Blocker for worker_analysis.
